content.text: Dose in HFrEF (start low, double every two weeks): metoprolol succinate 25 mg once daily (NYHA II) or 12.5 mg (more severe), up to 200 mg; carvedilol 3.125 mg BID for 2 weeks, then 6.25, 12.5 and 25 mg BID, after fluid retention is minimized.

digoxin, clonidine, diltiazem and verapamil add bradycardia (slowed AV conduction); stopping clonidine: withdraw the beta-blocker several days first (rebound HTN). Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (fluoxetine, paroxetine, quinidine) can double metoprolol levels. Higher epinephrine doses may be needed.

severe bradycardia, hypotension, AV block, bronchospasm and cardiogenic shock. Treat bradycardia with atropine, adrenergic drugs or pacing; hypotension with IV vasopressors; shock with glucagon (bolus, then infusion if needed). Hemodialysis is unlikely to help with metoprolol.
